evidence.quote: Today, the Federal Open Market Committee maintained the target range for the federal funds rate at ¼ to ½ percent.
For 2017 and 2018, the median projection is ¼ to ½ percentage point lower than in March
However, more recently the pace of improvement in the labor market appears to have slowed markedly.
monetary policy can more effectively respond to surprisingly strong inflation pressures in the future than to a weakening labor market and falling inflation.
financial market measures of inflation compensation have declined.
Every meeting is live; there is no meeting that is off the table

parsed.rationale: Rates held with downward-revised dot projections, emphasis on a sharp labor-market slowdown, below-target inflation, Brexit/global risks and asymmetric caution all point dovish. The Chair kept the door open to gradual hikes and noted solid fundamentals, so the lean is moderate rather than strong.
